pageDescription: Manage reusable skills injected into app system prompts
noPermission: No permission to access skill management
name: Name
nameHelp: kebab-case: lowercase letters/digits separated by single hyphens, e.g. weekly-report-format
nameInvalid: Must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
descriptionPlaceholder: Use when the user asks for a weekly report; describes the required structure and tone...
descriptionHelp: Recommended "Use when ..." style so the model knows when to apply this skill
requiresHelp: Missing names only produce warnings on save; they never block
rejectedHint: The last review was rejected. Revise and resubmit.
diffLoadFailed: Failed to load comparison, please try again later
diffNoChanges: Draft is identical to the published version
diffDegradedNotice: Content too large: whole-line comparison only, no inline highlighting
diffKeyboardHint: Side-by-side comparison; press n for the next change, p for the previous one
skillInUse: Skill "{name}" is bound to {count} apps. Unbind it first, or it cannot be deleted.
unbindWarning: The skill will no longer be injected into this app's system prompt.
agentMdModeDesc: Prompt selection is managed by Agent.md; edit it on the app detail page
modelOverriddenByAgentMd: In Agent.md mode the frontmatter model takes over this setting
legacyDesc: This app uses the legacy prompt mode. Upgrade to Agent.md to manage the system prompt, model and skills in one file.
agentMdAlreadyExists: Agent.md already exists, loaded the current version
wechatUpgradeDisabled: Wechat apps cannot be upgraded to Agent.md yet
agentMdHelp: Full Agent.md text including frontmatter; validation errors are reported with line numbers on save
revertWarning: Agent.md will be removed and the app falls back to the legacy prompt configuration. This cannot be undone.
execAssetsDesc: Scripts, data and runtime configuration for an executable skill. Changes go back through review before they take effect at runtime.
assetDeleteWarning: This removes the draft asset only; the published snapshot is untouched until the next approval.
assetRevertNotice: This skill is published or rejected: any asset or runtime config change sends it back to draft.
assetRevertConfirmTitle: This sends the skill back to draft
assetRevertConfirmDesc: Asset and runtime config changes count as substantive edits. The skill returns to draft and must be resubmitted for review before it takes effect.
uploadDropzone: Drop files or a folder here
uploadHint: Up to {max} per file; kind is inferred from the top-level directory (scripts / data / assets / references) and can be changed
uploadDone: {ok, plural, =1 {1 file uploaded} other {# files uploaded}}
pathErrorAbsolute: Path must be relative to the skill directory
pathErrorHiddenSegment: Path cannot contain hidden segments starting with a dot; use writable subdirectories for persistent state
execEntrypointHint: Entry point relative to the skill root; locked by the platform, the model cannot change it
execImageHint: Only images registered in the platform allowlist can be used
execImageManual: Image allowlist unavailable — enter name:tag manually
execWritableSubdirsHint: Writable persistent state directories such as .report_state; preserved across versions
execNeedsLlmHint: Lets the container call the model through the platform gateway without seeing real credentials
execLlmMaxCallsHint: Cap on model gateway calls within a single run; the gateway returns 429 once it is exceeded. Leave empty for no skill-level limit.
execLlmMaxTotalTokensHint: Cap on total tokens within a single run; the gateway returns 429 once it is exceeded. Leave empty for no skill-level limit.
execLlmQuotaInvalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or leave empty for no limit
execWarmPoolHint: Keeps the container alive in the warm pool after a run to speed up the next start
